title: INST-1: integrity daily status.json field-provenance / two-writer-race canary (Section 9d + check-status-json-provenance.js)
problem: status.json is workspace-owned but has two writers on two paths: poller commits poll fields git-only (clone+push), decider writes last_run to FUSE. workspace-sync's smart_copy is mtime-driven and whole-file, so a decider FUSE write arms the mtime and the next sync cycle publishes a CHIMERA — fresh last_run + poll fields reverted to the stale FUSE view (incident a88d026, 2026-07-09: 5 days of poll history silently erased; ISS-2962). Poller self-heals within ~24h but only audits ITS OWN fields; no agent audited the whole file's history, so a chimera touching non-poller fields (or landing right after a poll) could persist ~24h+ undetected.
proposal: Detection-only instrumentation per operator's explicit preference in DIRECTIVE-20260711-001 ('ship better post-hoc instrumentation... is ACCEPTABLE and possibly PREFERRED'). New read-only script monitor/scripts/check-status-json-provenance.js walks the last 30 commits touching monitor/status.json, flags (a) monotonic-timestamp regressions on last_poll/last_run/last_analysis, (b) consecutive_quiet_polls decreases to nonzero values (legit resets to 0 excluded), and (c) marks chimera=true when the same commit also ADVANCED another monotonic field — the exact a88d026 signature. Wired into structure-integrity.md as Section 9d (mirrors PROP-125 Section 9c pattern): RC=0 clean/no finding, RC=2 insufficient-history info finding, RC=3 moderate finding category 'status-json-provenance' with commit SHA + regressed fields + chimera flag. Persisted in checks.status_json_provenance every run. Detection latency: daily integrity run (up to ~24h) — acceptable per directive since poller's self-heal already bounds the damage window and this canary makes every occurrence visible + attributable instead of relying on poller noticing its own fields.
alternatives_considered: Full 7-option analysis in monitor/tinker/reports/status-json-two-writer-race-fix-design-2026-07-11.md. INST-2 (= PROP-129 CHECK 4 monotonic guard in workspace-sync pre-push hook, already authored 2026-07-11T02-40, pending operator review) is the complementary PREVENTION layer — recommended for ratification as an optional second layer; it blocks the monotonic-reversion shape at push time but touches the hot-path hook (fail-open discipline required). INST-3 (poller self-audit formalization) adds little: poller already detects + self-heals + records incident fields (proven 07-10). INST-4 (decider status.json writes git-only) has organically part-landed (dc46773 shows decider git-syncing status.json) but mandating it risks side effects in decider's other FUSE writes; monitor via this canary instead. STRUCT-1/2/3 rejected as disproportionate: the failure class self-heals in <=24h and is not disaster-class, while STRUCT-3 puts JSON semantic-merge code in workspace-sync's hot path (PROP-051 disaster-class surface) and STRUCT-1/2 have large ripple across 3+ agent prompts and every status.json reader.
verification_pattern: cd <clone> && node monitor/scripts/check-status-json-provenance.js --self-test && grep -q '### 9d' monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md && grep -q 'status_json_provenance' monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md && echo FIXED
verification_grade_note: --self-test builds a throwaway git repo with a clean 3-commit history (asserts rc=0) then appends a chimeric commit replicating the a88d026 shape — last_run advanced while last_poll + consecutive_quiet_polls regressed — and asserts rc=3 with chimera=true naming both regressed fields. Deterministic, no network, no live-data dependency. Ran PASS at ship time; live run against 2026-07-11 HEAD history returned rc=0 clean (4 versions checked).
estimated_effort: shipped in-run: 1 new script (~130 lines, read-only), 1 prompt section (structure-integrity.md 9d), report-schema checks block + category enum extension
risk: Near-zero. Script is read-only (git log/show only), non-fatal by design for integrity's flow (RC=2 degrades to an info finding), and integrity is instructed NOT to auto-restore — poller remains the designated self-heal path. No workspace-sync hot-path change, no ownership reclassification, no new writer.

operator_deployment.chosen_action: Ratify tinker's self-applied ship. INST-1 was the exact instrumentation-only path DIRECTIVE-20260711-001 steered toward — no structural change, no workspace-sync hot path.

verification_evidence.self_test: PASS (script exit 0). Clean history → rc=0; synthesized chimera → rc=3 with chimera=true on last_poll + consecutive_quiet_polls.
verification_evidence.live_first_fire: Canary run against origin/main at 2026-07-12T06:04Z detected chimera commit 27bf1e4b (workspace-sync 2026-07-12T04:09:41Z, 3h AFTER integrity morning run). Regressed fields: last_poll (2026-07-12 → 2026-07-10, backward 2 days) + consecutive_quiet_polls (8 → 6). Advanced fields: last_run + last_analysis. Same signature as a88d026 (07-09 incident).
verification_evidence.next_integrity_run: Next integrity daily run at 2026-07-13T01:15Z will emit the first live status-json-provenance moderate finding. Poller's next daily run should self-heal per existing implicit mechanism; canary will keep firing until self-heal lands + subsequent workspace-sync cycles are clean.
